native_processing.generation: WanI2VCausal.generate -> generate_causal_fast, image aspect/VAE8/patch2; lat_f=((F-1)//4+1), floor to chunk_size4
native_processing.decoder: WanVAE.decode -> WanVAE_.decode; first latent emits1; two cached temporal upsample3d stages emit4 per subsequent latent; frames=1+4*(latent_frames-1)
native_processing.camera: poses.npy OpenCV C2W -> linear translation/Slerp rotation at linspace(0,F-1,latent_frames); compute_relative_poses(framewise=True,normalize_trans=True) owned by native source
native_processing.intrinsics: Native get_Ks_transformed assumes832x480 calibration reference. Adapter rescales original K to reference; native maps reference to actual output. Original q0 bytes unchanged.

minimal_padding.tail: repeat original final C2W, never edit original files

native_processing.source_binding: Both backbones use shared LingbotCore and native WanI2VCausal. Each external image2video/vae/cam_utils still verified against configs/backbones/source_locks.json by planner before execution.
